description: Amazon Macie enabled but no classification jobs or automated discovery configured
rationale: The Macie session is explicitly ENABLED, automated sensitive data discovery is explicitly DISABLED, and a completed classification-job inventory is empty. The region has no observed configured classification mechanism, which does not prove absence of S3 data or organization-wide compliance.
remediation: Enable automated sensitive data discovery or configure appropriate classification jobs and verify bucket/account scope, IAM/KMS access and successful execution.
